name: MonarchAddressAutocomplete
title: AddressAutocomplete
wrapsNative: Button field that presents a .sheet with a NavigationStack, a List and .searchable(text:placement:prompt:), a debounced search in .task(id:), and a form of MonarchTextField with textContentType(.streetAddressLine1 …) and MonarchCombobox over Locale.Region.isoRegions
summary: An address field with suggestions from the app's own provider: search, pick a suggestion, and the street, city, region, postal code and country fill in for review, with manual entry one step away.
whenToUse: For a postal address in checkout, billing, shipping or a profile, when the app has an address provider (its own endpoint, or MKLocalSearchCompleter behind a closure).
whenNotToUse: Not for a place or point of interest on a map (use a map search), and not when no provider is available (use the address form of MonarchTextField fields with address text content types).
api: init(_ label: String? = nil, address: Binding<MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress>, mode: Binding<MonarchAddressAutocompleteMode>? = nil, helper: String? = nil, initialQuery: String = "", error: String? = nil, fieldErrors: [MonarchAddressAutocompleteField: String] = [:], isRequired: Bool = false, allowsManualEntry: Bool = true, minQueryLength: Int = 3, debounce: Duration = .milliseconds(300), labels: MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels = MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels(), search: @escaping @Sendable (String) async throws -> [MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion], resolve: (@Sendable (MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion) async throws -> MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress)? = nil, onSuggestionSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion, MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress) -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress: Hashable, Sendable { var line1: String; var line2: String; var city: String; var region: String; var postalCode: String; var countryCode: String?; var isEmpty: Bool { get }; init(line1: String = "", line2: String = "", city: String = "", region: String = "", postalCode: String = "", countryCode: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable { init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil, address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress? = nil) }
enum MonarchAddressAutocompleteField { case line1, line2, city, region, postalCode, country }

struct MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels: Sendable { init(placeholder:searching:resolving:empty:searchFailed:resolveFailed:enterManually:backToSearch:filled:cancel:line1:line2:city:region:postalCode:country:optional:noAddress: String? = nil, tooShort: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, results: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: label
options.description: The search field's label and the sheet's title. "Address" when nil.

options.name: address
options.description: The address. A picked suggestion replaces it; the form edits its parts.

options.name: mode
options.description: The search field only, or the form, when the app owns it. Kept inside when nil, starting on the form when the address has a street line.

options.name: helper
options.description: Help text under the search field, also read as the hint.

options.name: error
options.description: An error under the search field; the field takes the danger border.

options.name: fieldErrors
options.description: Errors of the form's fields, shown under each field.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Marks the search field and the country as required.

options.name: allowsManualEntry
options.description: Offers "Enter the address manually" under the field and at the end of the list.

options.name: minQueryLength
options.description: The characters needed before search runs.

options.name: debounce
options.description: How long to wait after typing before search runs. A newer text cancels the wait and the older search.

options.name: search
options.description: Returns the suggestions for the trimmed text. Throw to show "Couldn’t search addresses." with Try again.

options.name: resolve
options.description: Turns a picked suggestion without an address into one. Throw to show the resolve error. Without it, such a suggestion fills only the street line.

options.name: onSuggestionSelect
options.description: Receives the picked suggestion and the address it gave.

options.name: initialQuery
options.description: Text to search for when the view appears; when it is not empty the search opens with it typed in.

states.name: search, empty
states.description: The search field shows the placeholder in the subtle text colour, with "Enter the address manually" under it.

states.name: searching
states.description: The sheet shows a progress row with "Searching…".

states.name: too short
states.description: The sheet asks for more characters and does not search.

states.name: search failed
states.description: The sheet shows the error with Try again, which reruns the same text.

states.name: no results
states.description: The sheet shows "No addresses found" and the manual entry row.

states.name: resolving
states.description: A progress row with "Getting the address details…" shows under the field and the field is disabled.

states.name: resolve failed
states.description: The resolve error shows under the field with an icon and is announced.

states.name: manual
states.description: The form shows street, apartment (optional), city, region, postal code and country, then "Search for an address".

states.name: disabled
states.description: Text takes the disabled colours and nothing responds.

appearance: The search field has the input background and border of a text field with a search symbol; it shows the address on one line once filled. Suggestions are list rows with a pin symbol, the label in the default text colour and the description in the muted colour. Dark and high-contrast themes resolve the same roles.
platformNotes: The web shows a combobox with a listbox popup under an input; on iPhone the search opens in a sheet with the system search field, as in Maps and checkout forms. The manual form uses the system address text content types so AutoFill offers the person's addresses, and the country list comes from Locale.Region.isoRegions named in the current locale. The web's LocationFields adapter (region and city pickers from data) and idPrefix are not offered: region and city are typed. Search and resolve are async closures cancelled through Swift task cancellation instead of an AbortSignal. Android uses the same name. Several closures are optional (resolve, onSuggestionSelect). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is resolve.
accessibility: The search field is one button labelled with the label ("Address"), whose value is the address on one line or "None" and whose hint is the error, the help text and "Required".
The number of suggestions ("3 addresses found") or "No addresses found" is announced when a search finishes.
"Address filled in. Check the details." is announced after a pick, and the resolve error is announced when it fails.
Each suggestion is a button read as its label and description; the pin symbol is decorative.
The form fields are standard text fields and a country combobox, each named by its label; the optional apartment line has "Optional" as help text.
Rows and buttons are at least 44 points high.
edgeCases: An answer that arrives after the text changed is dropped, because the task that asked for it was cancelled.
A suggestion without an address and without resolve fills only the street line, for review.
Leaving the search for manual entry keeps an existing street line; otherwise the typed text becomes the street line.
Long street lines wrap in the search field and in the form.

examples.title: Search, pick and review
examples.template:
MonarchAddressAutocomplete(
    {{label}},
    address: $shipping,
    helper: {{helper}},
    initialQuery: {{query}},
    isRequired: {{required}},
    labels: MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels(enterManually: {{enterManually}}),
    search: { query in
        Self.places.filter { $0.label.localizedStandardContains(query) }
    }
)
examples.setupTemplate:
@State private var shipping = MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress()

private nonisolated static let places = [
    MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(
        id: {{places.0.id}},
        label: {{places.0.label}},
        description: {{places.0.description}},
        address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress(line1: {{places.0.address.line1}}, city: {{places.0.address.city}}, region: {{places.0.address.region}}, postalCode: {{places.0.address.postalCode}}, countryCode: {{places.0.address.countryCode}})
    ),
    MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(
        id: {{places.1.id}},
        label: {{places.1.label}},
        description: {{places.1.description}},
        address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress(line1: {{places.1.address.line1}}, city: {{places.1.address.city}}, postalCode: {{places.1.address.postalCode}}, countryCode: {{places.1.address.countryCode}})
    ),
    MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(id: {{places.2.id}}, label: {{places.2.label}}, description: {{places.2.description}}),
]
examples.setup:
@State private var shipping = MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress()

private nonisolated static let places = [
    MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(
        id: "p1",
        label: "10 Market Street",
        description: "Springfield, OR 97477, United States",
        address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress(line1: "10 Market Street", city: "Springfield", region: "Oregon", postalCode: "97477", countryCode: "US")
    ),
    MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(
        id: "p2",
        label: "24 Harbour Road",
        description: "Bristol BS1 5TY, United Kingdom",
        address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress(line1: "24 Harbour Road", city: "Bristol", postalCode: "BS1 5TY", countryCode: "GB")
    ),
    MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(id: "p3", label: "8 Lindenweg", description: "10115 Berlin, Germany"),
]
examples.code:
MonarchAddressAutocomplete(
    "Address",
    address: $shipping,
    helper: "Try “Market”, “Harbour” or “Linden”.",
    initialQuery: "Market",
    isRequired: true,
    labels: MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels(enterManually: "Enter the address manually"),
    search: { query in
        Self.places.filter { $0.label.localizedStandardContains(query) }
    }
)
